about_the_game:
"Gong Gong! Please don't go..."

You awaken from a strange dream—your late grandfather was trying to tell you something.

"Po Po is in trouble... Meet me at Qing Ming."

Step into a heartfelt journey set over the Qing Ming Festival, where the living and the departed connect through precious memories and age-old traditions. As you explore a vibrant world steeped in culture and nostalgia, you uncover the truth behind your grandmother's hidden pain.

Features

  • Experience a handwritten story of love and loss. Something has been bothering your grandmother as of late. While you gently unravel the pieces of the mystery, you uncover the love story between her and your late grandfather. How do people show love, even when the person you love is gone?

  • Take a trip down memory lane. Learn more about how your grandparents met and the fond memories they share. The weekend of Qing Ming is a good time for you to relax and reminiscence about the past...

  • Explore the charming island of Singapore. Set in the sunny island of Singapore, see how charming this little red dot is. Experience many different aspects of life as a Singaporean, from buying food at the coffee shop, to taking the MRT after work.

  • Learn about the beautiful tradition of Qing Ming Festival. Uncover the hidden meaning behind Qing Ming Festival as you go through it for the first time, with the guidance of your grandmother.

  • 8 fun-filled minigames and over an hours' worth of gameplay. Play a variety of fun minigames that tell the story of simple daily life. Try your best to get a perfect grade, or simply relax and enjoy them at your own pace.

Clear Brightness is a narrative experience about grief, remembrance, and the unspoken bonds that hold families together for generations.

short_description: You awaken from a strange dream—your late grandfather was trying to tell you something. Explore the world of Qing Ming Festival in Singapore and uncover the truth behind your grandmother’s hidden pain... Can you help her before it's too late?
